cycle_token: RAI (and MET in the second loop)
note: Two separate V3-to-V2 flash-swap loops. In each, the actor takes WETH from a UniswapV3 pool, pays less WETH to a UniswapV2 pool, and the V2 pool sends RAI or MET straight back to the V3 pool, netting +0.012688 and +0.010240 WETH. The intermediate tokens close pool-to-pool without touching the actor, and the combined gain only narrowly exceeds the 0.022782 ETH gas fee.
